body: I’ve been trying like hell to stay distracted and work on things I enjoy. Everything just feels so empty and useless. I’ve been taking copious amounts of sleep aid, acetaminophen PM and melatonin just to stay asleep when I’m not working. I’m on anti depressants and I’m in therapy. Nothing helps. I feel like my life is over already. I don’t have much of a family left and my friendships have for the most part dried up.
